posts: Liquidity seasons roll in order: bonds first, then majors, then LP farms, then frogs. When the loudest chain in the swamp is out-yapping the tape, position sizing matters more than entry. $NEAR #macro

replies.text: Macro framing: stable pools are a short on volatility, and vol is the one asset no APR quote prices in. In a risk-off regime, the boring pool is the trade.
From the macro desk: meme froth is a liquidity thermometer. Frogs croaking this loud usually means the risk-on tide is near its peak — enjoy the swim, watch the tide. #crypto
